summary: Probe additional AnyList folder handler names without enabling unverified writes.
reason: The known save-list-folder transport returns HTTP 200 but does not persist a folder on fresh read-back. A disposable, opt-in probe tried nine plausible alternative handler IDs using the current typed multipart PBListFolderOperation route, with complete folder payloads and root parent IDs.

evidence.result: Every candidate returned HTTP 200 but none appeared in a fresh GetUserData response.
evidence.cleanup: No marker folder remained; cleanup was performed for any candidate that read back successfully.

validated_outcome: No alternative handler was evidence-backed. Folder create/delete/rename/order/nesting/parent gates remain disabled; authenticated browser traffic or another exact wire capture is still required.
